ev.q: Almost three quarters of respondents (74.6%) strongly or somewhat supported public health department monitoring of wastewater for infectious diseases
Support for wastewater monitoring was similar among persons of different races and ethnicities (p>0.9) but differed significantly by age, education, and marital status.
U.S. adult residents (74.6%) strongly or somewhat support wastewater monitoring
Support for wastewater monitoring was similar among persons of different races and ethnicities (p>0.9) but differed significantly by age, education, and marital status.
Porter Novelli Public Services § conducted a nationwide nine-question survey in English, developed with input from CDC

methods_quotes.q: Nonprobability quota sampling was used to select 1,016 respondents.
The sample was weighted by gender, age, region, race and ethnicity, and education to match the U.S. population composition using Current Population Survey proportions.
Statistical significance was determined at α = 0.05 using Pearson chi-square tests corrected for survey design.
